scope.scan: Every .json file recursively under the four packet directories; every dictionary with path and sha256 is a separate pin occurrence.
scope.purpose: Byte-for-byte bookkeeping only; no acceptance decision and no functional claim.
scope.pin_policy: Existing expected hashes and sizes are preserved as found. The checker never repins.
